profile_tracing.jpeg.caption: Armen's pencil tracing of the fender's inner top edge (2026-09-11). Baseline with ticks at 50 and 90 mm; heights above the paper edge 28 / 24 / 10 mm at 0 / 50 / 90. Cabin end at the left, hinge (steep end) at the right. The 0 tick is just off the left edge.

ebay_outer_face.jpeg.caption: eBay: real ramp M-3798-4, outer face: two vent grilles, seven ribbed panels, four latch hooks on the side edges, hinge pins at the bottom

ebay_hinge_closeup.jpeg.caption: eBay: hinge bar with lobed ears and outward pins

ebay_three_quarter.jpeg.caption: eBay: three-quarter view of the real ramp

ebay_edge_profile.jpeg.caption: eBay: edge-on, shows the arch and the hinge-end flange (a perspective photo, not to scale)

ebay_bottom_view.png.caption: eBay: inside face with the tray rim

web_front_iso_closed.jpeg.caption: yojoe.com right-front iso, ramp closed: the ramp's vertical front face (RAMP ACCESS label) is a band below the fender top line, roughly twice our 10 mm, and a round black hinge boss sits on the black nose at each bottom corner of it (2026-09-13)

web_front_straight_closed.jpeg.caption: Straight-on front, ramp closed (web photo): the ramp's front face is inset between the fenders' front faces, hinge at its bottom edge, sled-launch door on the black nose below (2026-09-13)

web_front_iso_open.jpeg.caption: Front iso from slightly below, ramp lowered flat to the table (web photo, BLC): the ramp pivots at the top of the black nose and lies flat; the black boss at the nose corner is the hull-side hinge (2026-09-13)

hull_apart_0.jpeg.caption: Hull apart (2026-09-13): the two black corner fins of the middle layer seen from their inner faces. Round disc near the top edge, a horizontal rib and a small rectangular tab below it. Orientation unconfirmed.

hull_apart_1.jpeg.caption: Hull apart: middle layer held up, seen from below/behind, top shell off.

hull_apart_2.jpeg.caption: Hull apart: front of the middle layer from above, the two corner fins with grey remnants at their tips, sloped plate between them.

hull_apart_3.jpeg.caption: Hull apart: same front section from another angle, sled bay box and the corner fins.

hull_apart_4.jpeg.caption: Hull apart: middle layer from below, sled bay box hanging under the floor; green top shell beside it.

hull_apart_5.jpeg.caption: Hull apart: middle layer front, straight on (part inverted, labels upside down): the sled launch door panel between the two rounded fins, sled bay box behind.

hull_apart_6.jpeg.caption: Hull apart: middle layer front, right way up: rounded fins with oval recesses on their front faces, the sled bay mouth between them, two white latch tabs and a black post above it.

hull_apart_7.jpeg.caption: Hull apart, ruler in cm: a fin from the inside, screw hole with a screw head at its top corner, floor plate with a rectangular cutout and a white latch tab; fin top about 5.3 cm above the plate.

hull_apart_8.jpeg.caption: Hull apart, ruler in cm: front plate between the fins from above, two rectangular tabs and slots with the white latches at its inner end, the plate's free edge at the bottom.

hull_apart_9.jpeg.caption: Hull apart, ruler in cm: the LOWER hull from above, bay floor with two tread strips (10 cm across between the side rails), left channel with slots, screw bosses in the corners.
